div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p:
"light on/off" comes from the hysteresis:
on at ≥ lightOnThreshold,
off at ≤ lightOffThreshold.
Invalid readings freeze the machine
and raise SensorFailure once.
